To determine the total time taken by each team to complete the race and how this relates to the difference in their times:

### Well-Rounded Team:
Each member runs 400 meters in exactly 55 seconds. Since there are four members on the team, the total time is calculated as follows:
\[ \text{Total Time} = 4 \times 55 \text{ seconds} = 220 \text{ seconds} \]

### Less Well-Rounded Team:
The first runner runs in 60 seconds. Each subsequent runner is 3 seconds faster than the previous one.

- First runner: \(60\) seconds
- Second runner: \(60 - 3 = 57\) seconds
- Third runner: \(57 - 3 = 54\) seconds
- Fourth runner: \(54 - 3 = 51\) seconds

The total time for the less well-rounded team is:
\[ \text{Total Time} = 60 + 57 + 54 + 51 = 222 \text{ seconds} \]

### Difference in Times:
To find out how many seconds the faster team wins by, we subtract the total time of the well-rounded team from the total time of the less well-rounded team:
\[ \text{Difference} = 222 - 220 = 2 \text{ seconds} \]

Thus, the well-rounded team finishes 2 seconds ahead of the less well-rounded team.
